f_fabric_swap.intro: FABRIC SWAP TASK: Replace the fabric, print, and pattern of the garment with the new swatch shown in the fabric reference image. Preserve the exact garment construction — neckline, silhouette, seams, hemline, sleeves, collar, cuffs, and all structural details remain UNCHANGED. Only the surface fabric changes.
f_fabric_swap.swatch_fidelity: FABRIC FIDELITY — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The new fabric must match the swatch reference image EXACTLY — same color values, same pattern motifs, same hue, same saturation, same brightness. Do NOT alter, simplify, reinterpret, or recolor any element of the swatch pattern. SEAMLESS REPEAT — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The swatch shows a SINGLE REPEAT UNIT of a continuous seamlessly tiling fabric. Tile this pattern continuously across the entire garment with NO visible seam lines, NO grid lines, NO repeat boundaries anywhere — the pattern must flow uninterrupted across all panels and seams of the garment. FABRIC REALISM — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The print must integrate into the actual fabric surface — conforming to the garment's 3D form, drape lines, fold creases, seam curves, and body contours. Shadows in folds and highlights on raised areas must modulate the print exactly as real printed textile behaves. The fabric must respond physically to light — deep fold shadows, brightening on raised areas facing the light, color shift as fabric curves away from the source. Show micro-texture of woven threads. The pattern warps slightly over the body's curves. The result must look like genuine fabric PRINTED or WOVEN with this pattern — NOT a digital overlay or flat composite placed on top. If a fabric type is specified, render the drape, fold behavior, surface texture, and light response of that specific material accurately.
f_fabric_swap.target_full_outfit: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the ENTIRE outfit — top, bottom, and all garment pieces visible in this shot.
f_fabric_swap.target_topwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the TOP GARMENT ONLY — shirt, blouse, top, or jacket. Do NOT alter the fabric of any bottom garment, skirt, trousers, or footwear.
f_fabric_swap.target_bottomwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the BOTTOM GARMENT ONLY — trousers, skirt, or shorts. Do NOT alter the fabric of any top garment.
f_fabric_swap.target_innerwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the INNERWEAR ONLY. Do NOT alter any outerwear or other garment layer.
f_fabric_swap.target_outerwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric on the OUTERWEAR ONLY — jacket, coat, or hoodie. Do NOT alter any inner garment layer.
f_fabric_swap.target_footwear: FABRIC TARGET: Replace the fabric or material on the FOOTWEAR ONLY. Do NOT alter any clothing garments.
f_fabric_swap.construction_lock: CONSTRUCTION — NON-NEGOTIABLE: The garment's physical construction must be IDENTICAL to the product reference image — same silhouette, same cut, same seam lines, same hemline, same neckline, same collar, same sleeve style, same cuffs, same buttons, same pockets, same waist details. The only change is the surface fabric. Do NOT alter any structural element of the garment.

b_core_prompt: GARMENT: Reproduce exact garment from reference image 2 — every design detail, color, and construction accurate.
d_core_prompt: The garment should fit naturally on the person's body.

lighting_presets.name: Studio — Soft Diffused
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft, even, diffused studio lighting with no strong directional source. Consistent brightness and color temperature across the entire figure. No harsh shadows. The model must look naturally and evenly lit from all sides within a studio environment.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, subtle shadow falls directly below the model's feet onto the studio floor — close to the body, minimal spread, no strong directional cast. This gently anchors the model to the ground.

lighting_presets.name: Natural Ambient
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Natural indoor ambient light — soft, slightly warm, with no dominant single light source. Light wraps gently around the model from multiple directions as it would in a well-lit interior space. The model must look naturally lit within the scene, as if physically standing in the room.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, diffused shadow falls below and slightly behind the model's feet, consistent with gentle ambient lighting from above. No harsh edges — the shadow blends naturally into the floor surface and anchors the model to the ground.

lighting_presets.name: Golden Hour — Warm, Left
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Warm golden hour light coming from the left side of the scene. Warm orange-amber color temperature, creating a soft glow on the left side of the model and gentle warm shadows on the right. The overall image should feel warm and cinematic.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A warm-toned shadow falls to the right of the model's feet, consistent with a warm light source on the left. The shadow is elongated and soft-edged, following the floor surface naturally.

lighting_presets.name: Cool Daylight — Overcast
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Cool, soft overcast daylight — as if shooting on a cloudy day or near a large north-facing window. Even, slightly cool color temperature with no strong directional source. Flattering and clean with soft gradients rather than hard shadows.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A minimal, very soft shadow falls directly below the model's feet. Due to overcast light the shadow has very soft edges and low contrast — subtle but present to anchor the model to the surface.

lighting_presets.name: Dramatic Side Light
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Strong, dramatic directional light from the left side. Bold contrast between the lit left side of the model and the shadowed right side. Slightly warm-neutral color temperature. Creates a high-fashion, editorial mood.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A strong, defined shadow falls to the right of the model's feet, consistent with a dominant light source from the left. The shadow has visible edges and extends noticeably to the right across the floor surface.

lighting_presets.name: Soft Window Light
lighting_presets.lighting: LIGHTING: Soft, gentle light from a window on the left side of the scene. Natural, slightly warm color temperature. Creates a gentle gradation from lit (left) to slightly shadowed (right) on the model. Feels intimate and natural — not harsh or dramatic.
lighting_presets.shadow: SHADOW: A soft, feathered shadow falls gently to the right of the model's feet, consistent with soft window light from the left. The shadow has a gradual, diffused edge that fades into the floor surface naturally.
